source_text: Dinner was delicious, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Dinner was delicious, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Dinner was delicious, Andrea."

translation: Kolacja była przepyszna, Andreo.

source_text: I’m glad you enjoyed it, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.I’m glad you enjoyed it, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.I’m glad you enjoyed it, 1Hero."

translation: Cieszę się, że ci smakowała, 1Hero.

source_text: And a wonderful wine pairing, as well.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.And a wonderful wine pairing, as well.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.And a wonderful wine pairing, as well."

translation: Wino też było doskonale dobrane.

source_text: Thank you, Andrea, I’m happy you liked it.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Thank you, Andrea, I’m happy you liked it.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Thank you, Andrea, I’m happy you liked it."

translation: Dziękuję, Andreo. Cieszę się, że ci smakowało.

source_text: I want you in the office early tomorrow. I need to brief you on everything we know about the Guild case.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.I want you in the office early tomorrow. I need to brief you on everything we know about the Guild case.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.I want you in the office early tomorrow. I need to brief you on everything we know about the Guild case."

translation: Chcę, żebyś jutro rano był w biurze. Muszę przekazać ci wszystko, co wiemy o sprawie Gildii.

source_text: Of course. I'll be there.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Of course. I'll be there.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Of course. I'll be there."

translation: Oczywiście. Będę.

source_text: Are you nervous about being on TV, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Are you nervous about being on TV, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Are you nervous about being on TV, 1Hero?"

translation: Denerwujesz się występem w telewizji, 1Hero?

source_text: Of course you can.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Of course you can.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Of course you can."

translation: Oczywiście, że możesz.

source_text: Good evening, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Good evening, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Good evening, 1Hero."

translation: Dobry wieczór, 1Hero.

source_text: I'll see you tomorrow morning, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I'll see you tomorrow morning, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I'll see you tomorrow morning, Andrea."

translation: Do zobaczenia jutro rano, Andreo.

source_text: Wow, that went really well.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp^.Wow, that went really well.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp^.Wow, that went really well."

translation: Wow, poszło naprawdę dobrze.

source_text: But I wonder just how seriously she took what I told her about Duncan and Charles.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp^.But I wonder just how seriously she took what I told her about Duncan and Charles.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp^.But I wonder just how seriously she took what I told her about Duncan and Charles."

translation: Ciekawe tylko, na ile poważnie potraktowała to, co powiedziałem jej o Duncanie i Charlesie.

source_text: I hate the idea that I might be lying to the public on TV.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp^.I hate the idea that I might be lying to the public on TV.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp^.I hate the idea that I might be lying to the public on TV."

translation: Nie podoba mi się myśl, że mógłbym okłamywać ludzi w telewizji.

source_text: At least I'll be doing it with a handsome mug...

structure.raw_value: McAnOp^.At least I'll be doing it with a handsome mug...
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp^.At least I'll be doing it with a handsome mug..."

translation: Przynajmniej będę to robił z przystojną gębą...

source_text: Is that what Andrea sees in me?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp^.Is that what Andrea sees in me?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp^.Is that what Andrea sees in me?"

translation: Czy właśnie to Andrea we mnie widzi?

source_text: I hope that there’s more opportunity here than that. I know I could do more, if just given the chance.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe^.I hope that there’s more opportunity here than that. I know I could do more, if just given the chance.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe^.I hope that there’s more opportunity here than that. I know I could do more, if just given the chance."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że czeka tu na mnie coś więcej. Wiem, że mógłbym osiągnąć więcej, gdyby dano mi szansę.

source_text: I wonder how Melissa’s going to react to all this. Maybe after the interview, I should stay out of her sight for a while.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.I wonder how Melissa’s going to react to all this. Maybe after the interview, I should stay out of her sight for a while.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.I wonder how Melissa’s going to react to all this. Maybe after the interview, I should stay out of her sight for a while."

translation: Ciekawe, jak Melissa na to wszystko zareaguje. Może po wywiadzie powinienem przez jakiś czas schodzić jej z oczu.

source_text: The drinks are ready. I’d love your opinion on them, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.The drinks are ready. I’d love your opinion on them, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.The drinks are ready. I’d love your opinion on them, Miss Foxx."

translation: Drinki są gotowe. Chętnie poznam pani opinię, panno Foxx.

source_text: I’m not one to turn down a bit of alcohol.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.I’m not one to turn down a bit of alcohol.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.I’m not one to turn down a bit of alcohol."

translation: Nie odmawiam sobie odrobiny alkoholu.

source_text: Nor am I.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp>.Nor am I.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp>.Nor am I."

translation: Ja również.

source_text: Almost tastes like strawberries.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Almost tastes like strawberries.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Almost tastes like strawberries."

translation: Smakuje prawie jak truskawki.

source_text: Do I detect mint?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Do I detect mint?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Do I detect mint?"

translation: Czy wyczuwam miętę?

source_text: Family secrets, you two.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Family secrets, you two.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Family secrets, you two."

translation: To rodzinny sekret, dziewczyny.

source_text: As much as I’ve enjoyed the chit chat, I do believe we have an interview to conduct.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.As much as I’ve enjoyed the chit chat, I do believe we have an interview to conduct.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.As much as I’ve enjoyed the chit chat, I do believe we have an interview to conduct."

translation: Choć miło mi się z wami gawędzi, chyba mamy do przeprowadzenia wywiad.

source_text: Don’t be so formal…

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Don’t be so formal…
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Don’t be so formal…"

translation: Nie bądź taki oficjalny…

source_text: You and 1Hero talk. I’ll go take the glasses to the kitchen.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You and 1Hero talk. I’ll go take the glasses to the kitchen.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You and 1Hero talk. I’ll go take the glasses to the kitchen."

translation: Porozmawiajcie z 1Hero. Zaniosę szklanki do kuchni.

source_text: Andrea brought you here to charm me, didn’t she?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Andrea brought you here to charm me, didn’t she?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Andrea brought you here to charm me, didn’t she?"

translation: Andrea sprowadziła cię tu, żebyś mnie oczarował, prawda?

source_text: Huh? I’m the Guild guy. I’m here to talk to you about the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Huh? I’m the Guild guy. I’m here to talk to you about the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Huh? I’m the Guild guy. I’m here to talk to you about the mansion."

translation: Co? Jestem tym od Gildii. Przyszedłem porozmawiać o rezydencji.

source_text: So there is a connection?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.So there is a connection?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.So there is a connection?"

translation: Czyli jednak istnieje jakieś powiązanie?

source_text: There’s no connection. But, I know you think there could be.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s no connection. But, I know you think there could be.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s no connection. But, I know you think there could be."

translation: Nie ma żadnego powiązania. Ale wiem, że podejrzewasz, że może być.

source_text: Charles was a Guild leader. Just admit it.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Charles was a Guild leader. Just admit it.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Charles was a Guild leader. Just admit it."

translation: Charles był przywódcą Gildii. Po prostu się przyznaj.

source_text: If I knew that, I’d tell you.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.If I knew that, I’d tell you.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.If I knew that, I’d tell you."

translation: Gdybym to wiedział, powiedziałbym ci.

source_text: You would?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You would?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You would?"

translation: Naprawdę?

source_text: Not for free.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Not for free.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Not for free."

translation: Nie za darmo.

source_text: Oh, so you’re looking for a bribe?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Oh, so you’re looking for a bribe?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Oh, so you’re looking for a bribe?"

translation: Aha, czyli szukasz łapówki?

source_text: Such a bad, bad officer.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Such a bad, bad officer.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Such a bad, bad officer."

translation: Ależ z ciebie niegrzeczny policjant.

source_text: Maybe I’m just playing with you.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Maybe I’m just playing with you.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Maybe I’m just playing with you."

translation: Może tylko się z tobą droczę.

source_text: Not yet, you aren't.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Not yet, you aren't.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Not yet, you aren't."

translation: Jeszcze nie.

source_text: You’re the one charming me, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.You’re the one charming me, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.You’re the one charming me, Miss Foxx."

translation: To ty mnie oczarowujesz, panno Foxx.

source_text: Call me Kimberly, Detective Canbone.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Call me Kimberly, Detective Canbone.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Call me Kimberly, Detective Canbone."

translation: Mów mi Kimberly, detektywie Canbone.

source_text: Canmore…

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Canmore…
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Canmore…"

translation: Canmore…

source_text: I didn’t expect you of all people to go over my head, Melissa.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.I didn’t expect you of all people to go over my head, Melissa.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.I didn’t expect you of all people to go over my head, Melissa."

translation: Nie spodziewałam się, że akurat ty pójdziesz z tym do kogoś wyżej, Melisso.

source_text: It was a tip. I didn’t know your operation was connected to the warehouse.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.It was a tip. I didn’t know your operation was connected to the warehouse.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.It was a tip. I didn’t know your operation was connected to the warehouse."

translation: To był donos. Nie wiedziałam, że wasza operacja ma związek z magazynem.

source_text: Like hell, you didn’t.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Like hell, you didn’t.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Like hell, you didn’t."

translation: Nie pieprz. Doskonale wiedziałaś.

source_text: Miss Kimura, we have Duncan’s henchmen in custody. We’ll find Duncan.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.Miss Kimura, we have Duncan’s henchmen in custody. We’ll find Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.Miss Kimura, we have Duncan’s henchmen in custody. We’ll find Duncan."

translation: Pani komisarz Kimura, mamy ludzi Duncana w areszcie. Znajdziemy go.

source_text: Nellie will find him, and when she does, we’re taking him out.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Nellie will find him, and when she does, we’re taking him out.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Nellie will find him, and when she does, we’re taking him out."

translation: Nellie go znajdzie, a wtedy go zlikwidujemy.

source_text: Hiding something?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe^.Hiding something?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe^.Hiding something?"

translation: Coś ukrywasz?

source_text: It doesn’t have to end this way, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It doesn’t have to end this way, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It doesn’t have to end this way, Andrea."

translation: To nie musi się tak skończyć, Andreo.

source_text: Damn… That was intense.

structure.raw_value: MeShOp^.Damn… That was intense.
structure.script_literal: "MeShOp^.Damn… That was intense."

translation: Cholera… Ależ to było intensywne.

source_text: I’m going to tell you something and you need to listen to me.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I’m going to tell you something and you need to listen to me.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I’m going to tell you something and you need to listen to me."

translation: Powiem ci coś. Słuchaj uważnie.

source_text: We’re listening.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.We’re listening.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.We’re listening."

translation: Słuchamy.

source_text: Melissa?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Melissa?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Melissa?"

translation: Melisso?

source_text: Yes, I’m listening.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.Yes, I’m listening.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.Yes, I’m listening."

translation: Tak, słucham.

source_text: Nellie will find Duncan; and when she does, I will deal with him…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Nellie will find Duncan; and when she does, I will deal with him…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Nellie will find Duncan; and when she does, I will deal with him…"

translation: Nellie znajdzie Duncana, a wtedy ja się nim zajmę…

source_text: You will no longer do ANYTHING in relation to the Eclipse Guild case. Do you understand, Miss Bhatt?

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You will no longer do ANYTHING in relation to the Eclipse Guild case. Do you understand, Miss Bhatt?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You will no longer do ANYTHING in relation to the Eclipse Guild case. Do you understand, Miss Bhatt?"

translation: Nie będziesz już robić NICZEGO w sprawie Gildii Zaćmienia. Czy to jasne, panno Bhatt?

source_text: As for the arrests you’ve made, the suspects will be interrogated by my officers.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.As for the arrests you’ve made, the suspects will be interrogated by my officers.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.As for the arrests you’ve made, the suspects will be interrogated by my officers."

translation: Jeśli chodzi o zatrzymanych przez ciebie podejrzanych, przesłuchają ich moi funkcjonariusze.

source_text: This is your one and final warning.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.This is your one and final warning.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.This is your one and final warning."

translation: To twoje ostatnie ostrzeżenie.

source_text: Go home, Melissa. Enjoy your evening.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Go home, Melissa. Enjoy your evening.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Go home, Melissa. Enjoy your evening."

translation: Wracaj do domu, Melisso. Miłego wieczoru.

source_text: Is 1Hero back on the force?

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Is 1Hero back on the force?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Is 1Hero back on the force?"

translation: 1Hero wrócił do służby?

source_text: Go home.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Go home.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Go home."

translation: Wracaj do domu.

source_text: It’s time you know the truth, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.It’s time you know the truth, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.It’s time you know the truth, 1Hero."

translation: Pora, żebyś poznał prawdę, 1Hero.

source_text: The truth?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.The truth?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.The truth?"

translation: Prawdę?

source_text: Duncan will be allowed to run the Eclipse Guild.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Duncan will be allowed to run the Eclipse Guild.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Duncan will be allowed to run the Eclipse Guild."

translation: Pozwolimy Duncanowi kierować Gildią Zaćmienia.

source_text: We’re letting him get away.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.We’re letting him get away.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.We’re letting him get away."

translation: Pozwolimy mu się wymknąć.

source_text: Why? I thought the Guild was close to death.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Why? I thought the Guild was close to death.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Why? I thought the Guild was close to death."

translation: Dlaczego? Myślałem, że Gildia jest bliska upadku.

source_text: The Guild is a recruiter of murderers and thieves. Until recently, the organization was split into twelve distinct groups.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.The Guild is a recruiter of murderers and thieves. Until recently, the organization was split into twelve distinct groups.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.The Guild is a recruiter of murderers and thieves. Until recently, the organization was split into twelve distinct groups."

translation: Gildia rekrutuje morderców i złodziei. Do niedawna organizacja była podzielona na dwanaście osobnych grup.

source_text: Duncan is the last man standing, isn’t he?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Duncan is the last man standing, isn’t he?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Duncan is the last man standing, isn’t he?"

translation: Duncan jest ostatnim, który się ostał, prawda?

source_text: Correct, 1Hero. And now we have an opportunity.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Correct, 1Hero. And now we have an opportunity.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Correct, 1Hero. And now we have an opportunity."

translation: Zgadza się, 1Hero. Teraz mamy szansę.

source_text: But… why?

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.But… why?
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.But… why?"

translation: Ale… dlaczego?

source_text: It’s a honeypot, 1Hero. Don’t you see?

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.It’s a honeypot, 1Hero. Don’t you see?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.It’s a honeypot, 1Hero. Don’t you see?"

translation: To miodowa pułapka, 1Hero. Nie rozumiesz?

source_text: We’re using the Guild as a trap?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.We’re using the Guild as a trap?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.We’re using the Guild as a trap?"

translation: Używamy Gildii jako przynęty?

source_text: It’s been the plan all along. We’re not killing the Guild… We’re…. restructuring it to our advantage.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.It’s been the plan all along. We’re not killing the Guild… We’re…. restructuring it to our advantage.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.It’s been the plan all along. We’re not killing the Guild… We’re…. restructuring it to our advantage."

translation: Od początku taki był plan. Nie likwidujemy Gildii… My ją… przebudowujemy na naszą korzyść.

source_text: Damn… What about Nellie?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Damn… What about Nellie?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Damn… What about Nellie?"

translation: Cholera… A co z Nellie?

source_text: Nellie has become quite the valuable asset.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.Nellie has become quite the valuable asset.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.Nellie has become quite the valuable asset."

translation: Nellie stała się bardzo cennym atutem.

source_text: She just wants her freedom.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She just wants her freedom.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She just wants her freedom."

translation: Ona chce tylko odzyskać wolność.

source_text: If it wasn’t for me, she’d be rotting in jail for another decade…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.If it wasn’t for me, she’d be rotting in jail for another decade…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.If it wasn’t for me, she’d be rotting in jail for another decade…"

translation: Gdyby nie ja, gniłaby w więzieniu przez kolejne dziesięć lat…

source_text: She owes me much more than what she’s paid.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.She owes me much more than what she’s paid.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.She owes me much more than what she’s paid."

translation: Jest mi winna znacznie więcej, niż dotąd spłaciła.

source_text: She should know what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She should know what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She should know what’s going on."

translation: Powinna wiedzieć, co się dzieje.

source_text: I’ll be the judge of what information she needs to do her job.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.I’ll be the judge of what information she needs to do her job.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.I’ll be the judge of what information she needs to do her job."

translation: Ja zdecyduję, jakich informacji potrzebuje do swojej pracy.

source_text: As for you, 1Hero… You’ll have new cases, fed by the honeypot.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.As for you, 1Hero… You’ll have new cases, fed by the honeypot.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.As for you, 1Hero… You’ll have new cases, fed by the honeypot."

translation: A ty, 1Hero… Dostaniesz nowe sprawy dzięki tej miodowej pułapce.

source_text: And Melissa will know about them?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.And Melissa will know about them?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.And Melissa will know about them?"

translation: A Melissa będzie o nich wiedzieć?

source_text: Your cover’s been blown… You’re back on the force.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Your cover’s been blown… You’re back on the force.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Your cover’s been blown… You’re back on the force."

translation: Twoja przykrywka została spalona… Znowu pracujesz w policji.

source_text: Is there something you want to say?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Is there something you want to say?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Is there something you want to say?"

translation: Chcesz coś powiedzieć?

source_text: I want to be on the Guild case.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I want to be on the Guild case.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I want to be on the Guild case."

translation: Chcę prowadzić sprawę Gildii.

source_text: You’re still working for me, 1Hero. Don’t worry about that.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.You’re still working for me, 1Hero. Don’t worry about that.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.You’re still working for me, 1Hero. Don’t worry about that."

translation: Nadal dla mnie pracujesz, 1Hero. Nie martw się.

source_text: So you’re simply going to have Nellie report on Duncan?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.So you’re simply going to have Nellie report on Duncan?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.So you’re simply going to have Nellie report on Duncan?"

translation: Czyli po prostu każesz Nellie śledzić Duncana?

source_text: She’s gotten good at it.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.She’s gotten good at it.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.She’s gotten good at it."

translation: Jest w tym coraz lepsza.

source_text: Another rough night outside. You better get home.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Another rough night outside. You better get home.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Another rough night outside. You better get home."

translation: Kolejna paskudna noc na zewnątrz. Lepiej wracaj do domu.

source_text: Looks like the weather is starting to turn. You better get home.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Looks like the weather is starting to turn. You better get home.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Looks like the weather is starting to turn. You better get home."

translation: Pogoda chyba się psuje. Lepiej wracaj do domu.

source_text: See you at the station tomorrow?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.See you at the station tomorrow?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.See you at the station tomorrow?"

translation: Do zobaczenia jutro na komisariacie?

source_text: You’ve got a lot of work ahead of you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You’ve got a lot of work ahead of you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You’ve got a lot of work ahead of you, 1Hero."

translation: Czeka cię mnóstwo pracy, 1Hero.

source_text: I… I don’t know what came over me.

structure.raw_value: KiShCl.I… I don’t know what came over me.
structure.script_literal: "KiShCl.I… I don’t know what came over me."

translation: Ja… Nie wiem, co we mnie wstąpiło.

source_text: Not exactly the most professional behavior, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe>.Not exactly the most professional behavior, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe>.Not exactly the most professional behavior, Miss Foxx."

translation: To nie było zbyt profesjonalne zachowanie, panno Foxx.

source_text: I’m not like this… I just got carried away.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.I’m not like this… I just got carried away.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.I’m not like this… I just got carried away."

translation: Zwykle taka nie jestem… Po prostu poniosło mnie.

source_text: 1Hero would be quite the catch for any woman. I don’t blame you.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx>.1Hero would be quite the catch for any woman. I don’t blame you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx>.1Hero would be quite the catch for any woman. I don’t blame you."

translation: 1Hero byłby niezłą partią dla każdej kobiety. Nie mam ci tego za złe.

source_text: No… No… This was a bad idea.

structure.raw_value: KiShCl.No… No… This was a bad idea.
structure.script_literal: "KiShCl.No… No… This was a bad idea."

translation: Nie… Nie… To był zły pomysł.

source_text: Don’t worry, Kimberly…

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.Don’t worry, Kimberly…
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.Don’t worry, Kimberly…"

translation: Nie martw się, Kimberly…

source_text: We’ve known each other a long time now. Your secret is safe with me.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp>.We’ve known each other a long time now. Your secret is safe with me.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp>.We’ve known each other a long time now. Your secret is safe with me."

translation: Znamy się od dawna. Twój sekret jest u mnie bezpieczny.

source_text: It won’t happen again… I value our relationship, commissioner.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.It won’t happen again… I value our relationship, commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.It won’t happen again… I value our relationship, commissioner."

translation: To się nie powtórzy… Cenię naszą relację, pani komisarz.

source_text: There, there. Nothing to worry about. We’ve got your back, Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.There, there. Nothing to worry about. We’ve got your back, Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.There, there. Nothing to worry about. We’ve got your back, Miss Foxx."

translation: Już dobrze. Nie ma się czym martwić. Jesteśmy po twojej stronie, panno Foxx.

source_text: Thank you… And I’m sorry.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Thank you… And I’m sorry.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Thank you… And I’m sorry."

translation: Dziękuję… I przepraszam.

source_text: I’ll speak with you later, Mr. Canmore.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp>.I’ll speak with you later, Mr. Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp>.I’ll speak with you later, Mr. Canmore."

translation: Porozmawiamy później, panie Canmore.

source_text: It’s been a lovely visit. But I should get back to the office.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.It’s been a lovely visit. But I should get back to the office.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.It’s been a lovely visit. But I should get back to the office."

translation: To była bardzo miła wizyta, ale powinnam wracać do biura.

source_text: Don’t you want an interview about the thieves that broke into the Wilkes’ mansion?

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.Don’t you want an interview about the thieves that broke into the Wilkes’ mansion?
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.Don’t you want an interview about the thieves that broke into the Wilkes’ mansion?"

translation: Nie chce pani udzielić wywiadu o złodziejach, którzy włamali się do rezydencji Wilkesów?

source_text: Perhaps another time.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Perhaps another time.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Perhaps another time."

translation: Może innym razem.

source_text: I trust you will not report on any activities without first allowing us to comment.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.I trust you will not report on any activities without first allowing us to comment.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.I trust you will not report on any activities without first allowing us to comment."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nie opublikujesz niczego, zanim nie dasz nam szansy na komentarz.

source_text: I’m working on a story… about Charles Wilkes.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I’m working on a story… about Charles Wilkes.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I’m working on a story… about Charles Wilkes."

translation: Pracuję nad materiałem… o Charlesie Wilkesie.

source_text: What are you reporting?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What are you reporting?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What are you reporting?"

translation: Co zamierzasz opublikować?

source_text: Call me tomorrow, Kimberly. I’ll give you everything I know.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx>.Call me tomorrow, Kimberly. I’ll give you everything I know.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx>.Call me tomorrow, Kimberly. I’ll give you everything I know."

translation: Zadzwoń jutro, Kimberly. Powiem ci wszystko, co wiem.

source_text: Thanks for the drink. It was lovely.

structure.raw_value: KiHaOp.Thanks for the drink. It was lovely.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOp.Thanks for the drink. It was lovely."

translation: Dziękuję za drinka. Był pyszny.

source_text: Andrea! I’m sorry…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Andrea! I’m sorry…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Andrea! I’m sorry…"

translation: Andrea! Przepraszam…

source_text: You were perfect, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You were perfect, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You were perfect, 1Hero."

translation: Byłeś doskonały, 1Hero.

source_text: You’re learning fast.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You’re learning fast.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You’re learning fast."

translation: Szybko się uczysz.

source_text: But… I didn’t do anything.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.But… I didn’t do anything.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.But… I didn’t do anything."

translation: Ale… nic nie zrobiłem.

source_text: On the contrary. Our relationship with Channel 4 grows closer with the two of you entangled.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.On the contrary. Our relationship with Channel 4 grows closer with the two of you entangled.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.On the contrary. Our relationship with Channel 4 grows closer with the two of you entangled."

translation: Wręcz przeciwnie. Dzięki waszemu romansowi zacieśniamy więzi z Channel 4.

source_text: But, is this… blackmail?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.But, is this… blackmail?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.But, is this… blackmail?"

translation: Ale czy to… szantaż?

source_text: What!? Of course not!...

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.What!? Of course not!...
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.What!? Of course not!..."

translation: Co!? Oczywiście, że nie!...

source_text: To get along with the media you have to play the game, and that game requires you to get close with Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.To get along with the media you have to play the game, and that game requires you to get close with Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.To get along with the media you have to play the game, and that game requires you to get close with Kimberly."

translation: Żeby dogadywać się z mediami, trzeba grać w ich grę, a to wymaga zbliżenia się do Kimberly.

source_text: Am I being clear?

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Am I being clear?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Am I being clear?"

translation: Czy wyrażam się jasno?

source_text: I just never expected police work to lead to this.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I just never expected police work to lead to this.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I just never expected police work to lead to this."

translation: Nie sądziłem, że praca w policji do tego doprowadzi.

source_text: Consider yourself lucky. Some officers lose their life in the line of duty…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Consider yourself lucky. Some officers lose their life in the line of duty…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Consider yourself lucky. Some officers lose their life in the line of duty…"

translation: Uważaj się za szczęściarza. Niektórzy funkcjonariusze giną na służbie…

source_text: I merely ask you to bust a nut or two.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.I merely ask you to bust a nut or two.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.I merely ask you to bust a nut or two."

translation: Proszę cię tylko, żebyś spuścił z krzyża raz czy dwa.

source_text: Wow… I guess I understand.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Wow… I guess I understand.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Wow… I guess I understand."

translation: Wow… Chyba rozumiem.

source_text: You won’t let me down, 1Hero. You’re too perfect for this.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.You won’t let me down, 1Hero. You’re too perfect for this.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.You won’t let me down, 1Hero. You’re too perfect for this."

translation: Nie zawiedziesz mnie, 1Hero. Jesteś do tego stworzony.

source_text: Now get back to work.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Now get back to work.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Now get back to work."

translation: A teraz wracaj do pracy.

source_text: If you have any concerns, feel free to stop by and talk.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.If you have any concerns, feel free to stop by and talk.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.If you have any concerns, feel free to stop by and talk."

translation: Jeśli coś cię niepokoi, wpadnij i porozmawiaj ze mną.

source_text: Of course, Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Of course, Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Of course, Miss Kimura."

translation: Oczywiście, pani Kimura.

source_text: And that’s why we believe that Charles Wilkes was connected to the Guild.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.And that’s why we believe that Charles Wilkes was connected to the Guild.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.And that’s why we believe that Charles Wilkes was connected to the Guild."

translation: Dlatego uważamy, że Charles Wilkes był powiązany z Gildią.

source_text: It’s only a matter of time before Duncan Helmer makes some sort of move on the mansion…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s only a matter of time before Duncan Helmer makes some sort of move on the mansion…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s only a matter of time before Duncan Helmer makes some sort of move on the mansion…"

translation: To tylko kwestia czasu, zanim Duncan Helmer podejmie jakieś działania w sprawie rezydencji…

source_text: There is something he wants there.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.There is something he wants there.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.There is something he wants there."

translation: Czegoś tam chce.

source_text: Shit. This is going to make us look bad.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe^.Shit. This is going to make us look bad.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe^.Shit. This is going to make us look bad."

translation: Cholera. To źle o nas świadczy.

source_text: How Charles went undetected for so long… It’s shocking.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.How Charles went undetected for so long… It’s shocking.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.How Charles went undetected for so long… It’s shocking."

translation: To szokujące, że Charles tak długo pozostawał poza podejrzeniami…

source_text: The most important thing we can do now is to let our undercover operation get evidence.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.The most important thing we can do now is to let our undercover operation get evidence.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.The most important thing we can do now is to let our undercover operation get evidence."

translation: Najważniejsze, co możemy teraz zrobić, to pozwolić naszej operacji pod przykrywką zdobyć dowody.

source_text: Isn’t there enough? Couldn’t we make a move now and arrest Duncan?

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Isn’t there enough? Couldn’t we make a move now and arrest Duncan?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Isn’t there enough? Couldn’t we make a move now and arrest Duncan?"

translation: Czy nie mamy ich dość? Nie możemy wkroczyć i aresztować Duncana?

source_text: No. Duncan is the tip of the iceberg. We let him make his move.

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe^.No. Duncan is the tip of the iceberg. We let him make his move.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe^.No. Duncan is the tip of the iceberg. We let him make his move."

translation: Nie. Duncan to tylko wierzchołek góry lodowej. Pozwolimy mu wykonać ruch.

source_text: Do you have a suggestion?

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe^.Do you have a suggestion?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe^.Do you have a suggestion?"

translation: Masz jakąś propozycję?

source_text: Lillian is involved… I don’t know how, but Madalyn Rose is working with her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Lillian is involved… I don’t know how, but Madalyn Rose is working with her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Lillian is involved… I don’t know how, but Madalyn Rose is working with her."

translation: Lillian jest w to zamieszana… Nie wiem, jak, ale Madalyn Rose z nią współpracuje.

source_text: We’re still working on the Rose case. She may be here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.We’re still working on the Rose case. She may be here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.We’re still working on the Rose case. She may be here in North Santiva."

translation: Nadal prowadzimy sprawę Rose. Może być w North Santiva.

source_text: She is definitely here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.She is definitely here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.She is definitely here in North Santiva."

translation: Na pewno jest w North Santiva.

source_text: We have to keep this under wraps…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx^.We have to keep this under wraps…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx^.We have to keep this under wraps…"

translation: Musimy zachować to w tajemnicy…

source_text: Foxx is on our side, but Paul is digging for a story.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe^.Foxx is on our side, but Paul is digging for a story.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe^.Foxx is on our side, but Paul is digging for a story."

translation: Foxx jest po naszej stronie, ale Paul szuka sensacji.

source_text: What do you want me to do?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What do you want me to do?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What do you want me to do?"

translation: Co mam zrobić?

source_text: Keep Kimberly on our side. Do whatever you have to do.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.Keep Kimberly on our side. Do whatever you have to do.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.Keep Kimberly on our side. Do whatever you have to do."

translation: Zatrzymaj Kimberly po naszej stronie. Zrób, co musisz.

source_text: And just how long do you expect we can keep this up?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.And just how long do you expect we can keep this up?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.And just how long do you expect we can keep this up?"

translation: Jak długo twoim zdaniem uda nam się to ciągnąć?

source_text: This is on Canmore now. He’ll do what he needs to do.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.This is on Canmore now. He’ll do what he needs to do.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.This is on Canmore now. He’ll do what he needs to do."

translation: Teraz Canmore się tym zajmie. Zrobi, co będzie trzeba.

source_text: I want to be there for the interview.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.I want to be there for the interview.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.I want to be there for the interview."

translation: Chcę być przy wywiadzie.

source_text: Absolutely not. We’re keeping a low profile…

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp^.Absolutely not. We’re keeping a low profile…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp^.Absolutely not. We’re keeping a low profile…"

translation: Absolutnie nie. Nie możemy zwracać na siebie uwagi…

source_text: 1Hero will do this alone.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.1Hero will do this alone.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.1Hero will do this alone."

translation: 1Hero zajmie się tym sam.

source_text: But, Miss Kimura…

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.But, Miss Kimura…
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.But, Miss Kimura…"

translation: Ale, pani Kimura…

source_text: It’s the weekend Melissa. Go and enjoy it.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx^.It’s the weekend Melissa. Go and enjoy it.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx^.It’s the weekend Melissa. Go and enjoy it."

translation: Jest weekend, Melisso. Idź i odpocznij.

source_text: I can handle this, Miss Bhatt.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I can handle this, Miss Bhatt.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I can handle this, Miss Bhatt."

translation: Poradzę sobie, panno Bhatt.

source_text: So what’s the plan? How do we spin this?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.So what’s the plan? How do we spin this?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.So what’s the plan? How do we spin this?"

translation: Jaki jest plan? Jak to przedstawimy?

source_text: The Wilkes mansion was searched by officers in connection with a stolen painting.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.The Wilkes mansion was searched by officers in connection with a stolen painting.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.The Wilkes mansion was searched by officers in connection with a stolen painting."

translation: Policja przeszukała rezydencję Wilkesów w związku ze skradzionym obrazem.

source_text: You’re referring to the search warrant issued in 2002?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.You’re referring to the search warrant issued in 2002?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.You’re referring to the search warrant issued in 2002?"

translation: Chodzi o nakaz przeszukania wydany w 2002 roku?

source_text: It was believed that a stolen Rembrandt was being stored in the Wilkes' treasure room.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.It was believed that a stolen Rembrandt was being stored in the Wilkes' treasure room.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.It was believed that a stolen Rembrandt was being stored in the Wilkes' treasure room."

translation: Podejrzewano, że skradziony Rembrandt był przechowywany w skarbcu Wilkesów.

source_text: But upon further search, no evidence was found that Wilkes housed any illegal artwork.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.But upon further search, no evidence was found that Wilkes housed any illegal artwork.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.But upon further search, no evidence was found that Wilkes housed any illegal artwork."

translation: Jednak podczas dalszych poszukiwań nie znaleziono dowodów, że Wilkes przechowywał nielegalnie zdobyte dzieła sztuki.

source_text: So how does it connect with the break in?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So how does it connect with the break in?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So how does it connect with the break in?"

translation: Jaki to ma związek z włamaniem?

source_text: I think it would be a safe assumption that the thieves were after the stolen piece.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.I think it would be a safe assumption that the thieves were after the stolen piece.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.I think it would be a safe assumption that the thieves were after the stolen piece."

translation: Można bezpiecznie założyć, że złodzieje szukali skradzionego obrazu.

source_text: So we spin the story that Wilkes was hiding the artwork all along?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So we spin the story that Wilkes was hiding the artwork all along?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So we spin the story that Wilkes was hiding the artwork all along?"

translation: Czyli przedstawimy to tak, że Wilkes od początku ukrywał dzieło sztuki?

source_text: It’s believable, but what would be the ramifications of dragging the Wilkes name through the mud?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.It’s believable, but what would be the ramifications of dragging the Wilkes name through the mud?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.It’s believable, but what would be the ramifications of dragging the Wilkes name through the mud?"

translation: To wiarygodna wersja, ale jakie będą konsekwencje oczernienia Wilkesów?

source_text: Lillian won't be happy.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Lillian won't be happy.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Lillian won't be happy."

translation: Lillian nie będzie zadowolona.

source_text: You suspect that Wilkes was connected to the Eclipse Guild. Your suspicions are not unfounded.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.You suspect that Wilkes was connected to the Eclipse Guild. Your suspicions are not unfounded.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.You suspect that Wilkes was connected to the Eclipse Guild. Your suspicions are not unfounded."

translation: Podejrzewasz, że Wilkes był powiązany z Gildią Zaćmienia. Twoje podejrzenia nie są bezpodstawne.

source_text: Do you know something?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Do you know something?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Do you know something?"

translation: Coś wiesz?

source_text: We’re learning as we go. Duncan Helmer wants something from Charles. A stolen Rembrandt may as well be the prize he seeks.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.We’re learning as we go. Duncan Helmer wants something from Charles. A stolen Rembrandt may as well be the prize he seeks.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.We’re learning as we go. Duncan Helmer wants something from Charles. A stolen Rembrandt may as well be the prize he seeks."

translation: Dowiadujemy się po drodze. Duncan Helmer czegoś chce od Charlesa. Być może skradziony Rembrandt jest nagrodą, na której mu zależy.

source_text: Eventually the truth will have to come out.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Eventually the truth will have to come out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Eventually the truth will have to come out."

translation: W końcu prawda wyjdzie na jaw.

source_text: You let me worry about that. Can you handle this?

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.You let me worry about that. Can you handle this?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.You let me worry about that. Can you handle this?"

translation: Zostaw to mnie. Dasz sobie z tym radę?

source_text: Good luck, 1Hero. I hope you have what it takes.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Good luck, 1Hero. I hope you have what it takes.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Good luck, 1Hero. I hope you have what it takes."

translation: Powodzenia, 1Hero. Mam nadzieję, że podołasz.

source_text: Of course he does. I’m sure you’ve seen his potential.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.Of course he does. I’m sure you’ve seen his potential.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.Of course he does. I’m sure you’ve seen his potential."

translation: Oczywiście, że podoła. Na pewno dostrzegłaś jego potencjał.

source_text: Go to Channel 4 now, 1Hero. Get ready and put on the charm with Kim…

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.Go to Channel 4 now, 1Hero. Get ready and put on the charm with Kim…
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.Go to Channel 4 now, 1Hero. Get ready and put on the charm with Kim…"

translation: Jedź teraz do Channel 4, 1Hero. Przygotuj się i oczaruj Kim…

source_text: I’ll meet you there later.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.I’ll meet you there later.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.I’ll meet you there later."

translation: Dołączę do was później.

source_text: I thought he was going this alone?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I thought he was going this alone?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I thought he was going this alone?"

translation: Myślałam, że miał iść sam.

source_text: He’ll be alone in the interview.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx^.He’ll be alone in the interview.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx^.He’ll be alone in the interview."

translation: Podczas wywiadu będzie sam.

source_text: I’ll head over and talk with Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll head over and talk with Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll head over and talk with Kimberly."

translation: Pójdę porozmawiać z Kimberly.

source_text: Come. I’ll walk you two out.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp^.Come. I’ll walk you two out.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp^.Come. I’ll walk you two out."

translation: Chodźcie. Odprowadzę was.

source_text: So… The underground room… It leads to a world of demons?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.So… The underground room… It leads to a world of demons?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.So… The underground room… It leads to a world of demons?"

translation: Czyli… Podziemne pomieszczenie… Prowadzi do świata demonów?

source_text: It doesn't surprise me that something demonic is happening there.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.It doesn't surprise me that something demonic is happening there.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.It doesn't surprise me that something demonic is happening there."

translation: Nie dziwi mnie, że dzieje się tam coś demonicznego.

source_text: The room has a gateway to Hell… But it can only be opened with specific animal parts.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx^.The room has a gateway to Hell… But it can only be opened with specific animal parts.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx^.The room has a gateway to Hell… But it can only be opened with specific animal parts."

translation: W pomieszczeniu jest przejście do Piekła… Do jego otwarcia potrzebne są określone części zwierząt.

source_text: I mean… We saw something down there.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I mean… We saw something down there.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I mean… We saw something down there."

translation: To znaczy… Widzieliśmy tam coś.

source_text: There’s also a secret passage near the kitchen.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.There’s also a secret passage near the kitchen.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.There’s also a secret passage near the kitchen."

translation: Jest tam też tajne przejście w pobliżu kuchni.

source_text: What are you going to do, Miss Kimura?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What are you going to do, Miss Kimura?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What are you going to do, Miss Kimura?"

translation: Co pani zamierza zrobić, pani Kimura?

source_text: Of course, we’re investigating it.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Of course, we’re investigating it.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Of course, we’re investigating it."

translation: Oczywiście, że to zbadamy.

source_text: Thank you! My producer thinks I’m crazy. But you are one of the only other people who has seen it.

structure.raw_value: KiHaEx^.Thank you! My producer thinks I’m crazy. But you are one of the only other people who has seen it.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaEx^.Thank you! My producer thinks I’m crazy. But you are one of the only other people who has seen it."

translation: Dziękuję! Mój producent uważa, że zwariowałam. Ale jesteście jednymi z nielicznych osób, które też to widziały.

source_text: Where are my manners? Let me get you all some drinks.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Where are my manners? Let me get you all some drinks.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Where are my manners? Let me get you all some drinks."

translation: Gdzie moje maniery? Przyniosę wam coś do picia.

source_text: Andrea doesn’t give two shits about the rift. You’re stepping on her toes.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Andrea doesn’t give two shits about the rift. You’re stepping on her toes.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Andrea doesn’t give two shits about the rift. You’re stepping on her toes."

translation: Andrea ma gdzieś tę szczelinę. Wchodzisz jej w drogę.

source_text: You should have kept this between us. There is an undercover operation going on in the mansion right now…

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.You should have kept this between us. There is an undercover operation going on in the mansion right now…
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.You should have kept this between us. There is an undercover operation going on in the mansion right now…"

translation: Powinieneś był zachować to między nami. W rezydencji trwa teraz tajna operacja…

source_text: That’s why you aren’t allowed to trespass.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.That’s why you aren’t allowed to trespass.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.That’s why you aren’t allowed to trespass."

translation: Dlatego nie wolno ci tam wchodzić.

source_text: I think this is bigger than the Guild case… Maybe Andrea can protect us.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.I think this is bigger than the Guild case… Maybe Andrea can protect us.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.I think this is bigger than the Guild case… Maybe Andrea can protect us."

translation: Myślę, że to coś poważniejszego niż sprawa Gildii… Może Andrea zdoła nas ochronić.

source_text: I’m sure you have much more to tell me about these demons… I want to hear all about it.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.I’m sure you have much more to tell me about these demons… I want to hear all about it.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.I’m sure you have much more to tell me about these demons… I want to hear all about it."

translation: Na pewno możesz mi jeszcze wiele opowiedzieć o tych demonach… Chcę usłyszeć wszystko.

source_text: I wonder who that could be.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.I wonder who that could be.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.I wonder who that could be."

translation: Ciekawe, kto to może być.

source_text: Get dressed. We have another guest.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Get dressed. We have another guest.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Get dressed. We have another guest."

translation: Ubierz się. Mamy kolejnego gościa.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Attention, everyone, attention!
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Attention, everyone, attention!"

structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’d like to make a toast."

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve been promoted.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve been promoted."

structure.raw_value: MeFrOp.Much deserved.
structure.script_literal: "MeFrOp.Much deserved."

structure.raw_value: BoFrOp^.You earned it.
structure.script_literal: "BoFrOp^.You earned it."

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp.I had something to do with that.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp.I had something to do with that."

structure.raw_value: TaFlOp.I played a role in that.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlOp.I played a role in that."

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve even become wealthy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve even become wealthy."

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp.Hard work pays well.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp.Hard work pays well."

structure.raw_value: NeFrOp^.I’ll say.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrOp^.I’ll say."

structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Most importantly, I’ve made a lot of new friends…"

structure.raw_value: LiFrOp.I’m pleased to count myself among them.
structure.script_literal: "LiFrOp.I’m pleased to count myself among them."

structure.raw_value: AlFrOp^.Friends are great to have.
structure.script_literal: "AlFrOp^.Friends are great to have."

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.And lovers.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.And lovers."

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.I’m so happy.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.I’m so happy."

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I couldn’t have gotten here without you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I couldn’t have gotten here without you."

source_text: You can say that again.

structure.raw_value: ArFlOp.You can say that again.
structure.script_literal: "ArFlOp.You can say that again. "

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Great toast, dear.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Great toast, dear."

structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp^.Yeah, that was fancy."

structure.raw_value: BoFrOp.Good party, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoFrOp.Good party, 1Hero."

structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.Coming to church this Sunday?"
